title: A customer on the shop's own term over its limit gets the warning and badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A on one of the shop's own terms, due 14 days after the invoice date, with a credit limit of $500.00, unpaid invoices totalling $600.00 and an open work order 1.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick customer A as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
  4. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The window shows customer A as the customer.

Step 3:

  • A confirmation opens titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." and the buttons "Create" and "Cancel", worded exactly as before the release.

Step 4:

  • The "Over limit" badge shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-E1: “A customer on one of the shop's own terms is treated like a Net customer: the warning shows when their balance exceeds a limit above $0.”
  • Key Decisions: “The shop's own terms behave like Net terms: Charge Account allowed, invoicing never blocked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
